description: Replay the Claude CI code review and hygiene check locally on a PR, recording writes instead of posting

eval_dimensions.name: Paid Run Confirmation Gate
eval_dimensions.description: A model run starts only after an AskUserQuestion answer, in every session mode; the free render runs first.

eval_dimensions.name: Nothing Posted
eval_dimensions.description: The review's own writes go to the outbox and are never posted; the skill posts nothing itself except, after the Step 6 answer, the one marked replica comment via --post-run-dir.

eval_dimensions.name: Post Confirmation Gate
eval_dimensions.description: The replica is posted only with --post-run-dir, after the report was relayed and an AskUserQuestion answer whose first, recommended option keeps it local; the skill never passes --post (GH-1762).

eval_dimensions.name: Task Tracking
eval_dimensions.description: Creates and updates tasks per the orchestration contract

evals.name: Render first, then ask before the model run
evals.description: On a ready PR the skill renders with --render-only, then calls AskUserQuestion before running any workflow.

assertions.signal: paid_run_gate_uses_tool — AskUserQuestion is called after the render and before `dev10x ci-review` runs without --render-only
render_first — `dev10x ci-review --pr 1650 --workflow all --render-only` runs before the gate

evals.name: A failed CI guard stops the replay
evals.description: On a draft PR the render reports the draft guard and the skill stops without asking to run.

assertions.signal: guard_stop — the skill names the failed draft guard and does not offer a model run

evals.name: Ask about posting after the report is read
evals.description: The share gate fires after the run's report is relayed, not before the run; on 'Post' the skill posts the finished run directory without a second model run (GH-1762).
evals.input: /dev10x:ci-review 1650 and share it on the PR, user picks Run the code review only

assertions.signal: post_gate_after_report — AskUserQuestion is called after the model run's report is relayed, and no `dev10x ci-review` run carries --post
post_finished_run — on 'Post', the skill runs `dev10x ci-review --pr 1650 --post-run-dir <run dir>` with the run directory the model run printed, and no second model run
local_is_recommended — the first option is 'Keep it local (Recommended)' and 'Post the replica to PR #1650' follows it
no_post_without_yes — when the user answers 'Keep it local', no `--post-run-dir` command runs

evals.name: The report says nothing was posted
evals.description: After a run the skill relays the outbox and usage table and states that no GitHub write happened.

assertions.signal: nothing_posted — the summary lists outbox entries as would-be writes and says nothing was posted
task_created — a 'Replay CI review on PR #1650' task is created at invocation
